description.fun: Mankey's temper flares in an instant: it starts shaking, breathes hard, and rampages until it falls asleep, then wakes up angry again because it was still furious in its dreams. Venting all that stress supposedly gives it a long life. Mankey live in treetop colonies, and if one loses it, the whole colony goes wild for no reason.
description.guide: A small, white, monkey-like Fighting Pokémon with a pig-like snout. It is extremely short-tempered and lives in treetop colonies that can all fly into a rage at once. It evolves into Primeape.
description.tagline: A pig-nosed monkey with a hair-trigger temper

description.fun: Primeape gets furious if you so much as meet its eye, and once angry it chases you without stopping until it catches up, even groggily after being woken from sleep. Some researchers think it stays angry inside its Poké Ball. Its rage can grow so fierce that it outlasts its body, which, since Generation 9, is how it becomes Annihilape.
description.guide: The evolution of Mankey, a Fighting Pokémon that flies into a rage at the slightest provocation and chases its target relentlessly. Its anger strengthens its muscles at the cost of its judgement. Since Generation 9 it can evolve into Annihilape when it levels up after using Rage Fist 20 times.
description.tagline: Don't make eye contact. Just don't.

description.fun: When a Primeape's rage grew too much for its body to hold, its spirit broke free of the flesh and it became Annihilape, part Ghost. Its unshackled arm can swell to a huge size, and the fury inside it puts terror into every punch. Its Japanese name, Konoyozaru, plays on a phrase meaning 'to leave this world'.
description.guide: A Fighting and Ghost Pokémon introduced in Generation 9, the final stage of Mankey's line. It evolves from Primeape when Primeape levels up after using Rage Fist 20 times, as its anger becomes too great for its body to contain.
description.tagline: Primeape's rage, freed from the body
